findings.title: Critical resolution mismatch
findings.detail: Artwork is 150×150 pixels for a 3.0×3.0 inch print. This yields approximately 50 DPI, far below the target 300 DPI. A properly prepared file at 300 DPI would require 900×900 pixels. This severe undersampling will result in visible pixelation and blurred output.

findings.title: Visual composition acceptable
findings.detail: The layout is clean and centered with good contrast between the dark green badge and cream background. Text appears properly aligned within the design element.

findings.title: Colour reproduction unverified
findings.detail: Low-resolution preview cannot certify accurate colour reproduction for the dark green and cream tones. Actual printed colours may differ from screen display.
